description: Gets native gas (ETH, BNB or POL) on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon or Optimism for a wallet that holds USDC on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism or Polygon but has no gas to send transactions. Called with the paying chain, the receiving chain, the recipient, a USDC amount and the paying wallet (without it the offer has nothing to sign), it returns an offer: the fee, the minimum native amount, the deadline, the order and one USDC authorization for the wallet to sign; signing costs no gas. An offer needs 2 to 50 USDC (at least 5 USDC for gas on Ethereum) that covers the fee, a recipient that accepts the native coin and is not a token contract, and, for a cross-chain order, the paying wallet or a refundTo on the paying chain; otherwise, or while the route is paused, no offer is returned and the answer says why. Called again with the offer, the signature and the same wallet, it passes the signed order to Cleave's relayer, which executes it through a contract made for that one order, and returns a requestId for cleave_track_swap. On one chain the order swaps the USDC to the native coin for the recipient; from another chain it bridges the USDC and swaps it on arrival, delivering USDC instead if that swap fails. An authorization not used by its deadline expires and takes nothing. An order paid from another chain whose bridge transfer is not filled is usually refunded to the refund address on the paying chain within hours; until then, or if that USDC is worth less than sweeping it costs, cleave_track_swap shows it as refund_pending. When the wallet already holds some gas, cleave_plan_swap plans a swap to the native coin.

amount.description: A decimal amount in token units

name: cleave_get_gas
title: Get native gas with USDC
